overview.tagline: Fuuz Integration Accelerator — cross tenant — external connections package
description: A small, generic message-routing and staging application built on the FUUZ platform for connecting a Fuuz tenant to external ERP/host systems — the foundation other accelerators (MES, WMS, CMMS, QMS) build their integration flows on top of.

A Fuuz tenant needs a consistent, auditable way to exchange messages with external systems — an ERP, a host, or another platform — without every accelerator inventing its own integration pattern. The Integration Orchestrator provides a single configuration surface, message staging table, and dashboard that other Fuuz accelerators' packaged integration flows route through.

highlights.title: One integration pattern
highlights.body: A single configuration surface, message staging table and dashboard that other accelerators' integration flows route through.

highlights.title: Small and generic
highlights.body: 6 data models, 5 screens and 4 data flows, for any ERP, host or other platform.

highlights.title: See every message
highlights.body: Messages to and from external systems are staged and shown on the Integration Dashboard.

pricing.detail: Fuuz accelerators are no cost; you pay only for the Fuuz runtime.

support.sla: No service level agreement. Supported once implemented by a Fuuz services professional or an approved Fuuz partner.

security.externalDetail: It exchanges messages with the external ERP, host or other systems you configure on the Integration Setup screen.

steps.text: Review the import preview and confirm the import.
On the Integration Setup screen, define an Integration Configuration and Integration Type for each external system.
Watch message flow on the Integration Dashboard.
